description: Answer an athlete's reply, as the session's answer bar does: say what was done about it (moved, swapped, edited, rested, kept, deleted, answered) and a line for the athlete. Change the plan first with update_workout, move_workout, delete_workout or create_workouts; this marks the reply done and puts your line under it, where the athlete reads it on their Today card and in the morning email.

answer.description: A line for the athlete, in your words

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

resolution.description: What was done to the plan

name: answer_message
